GASTROENTEROLOGY PROCEDURE NOTE — 10/28/2024
Screening colonoscopy (family hx colon cancer in father at 58).
Prep: clear liquid diet day before, split-dose prep; prep adequate.
Findings: two 4 mm polyps in transverse colon, removed by cold snare; otherwise normal.
Plan: resume regular diet; pathology pending; repeat per pathology (likely 5 years given family history).

LAB RESULT NOTE — 02/21/2025
25-OH vitamin D 27 ng/mL — low-normal. Continue vitamin D3 2000 IU daily.

ANNUAL PHYSICAL — 10/14/2025
41 y/o F, annual exam. No acute complaints.
Vitals: Wt 98.3 kg, BMI 32.1, BP 116/68.
Social history: works as a school administrator; married, two kids. Has dieted on and off for years — "tried everything." Walks the dog most days. Nonsmoker, 1–2 drinks per week.
Exam normal. Screening: mammogram ordered; Pap/HPV up to date; colonoscopy 2024. Flu vaccine today.
Return 1 year.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/10/2026
S: 42 y/o F here to discuss weight. Long-standing efforts at diet and exercise — has tried calorie counting, low-carb, and commercial plans at various times, and walks the dog daily. Weight has been stable for years around the same range despite this. Wants to try medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis, no gallbladder disease. IUD in place.
O: Wt 97.7 kg, Ht 175 cm, BMI 31.9. BP 110/71.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 31.9 — Plan: start semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly (Wegovy) with standard dose titration; counseled on GI side effects. Recheck in 3 months.
2. Migraine — stable.
